d: Bharatiya Janata Party National Vice President Ram Madhav addressed a press conference in Chennai, defending the Election Commission of India's Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and dismissing allegations levelled by the Congress. Rejecting opposition claims that 13 crore voters were improperly removed, he said, "The real target is Prime Minister Narendra Modi." Madhav explained that the exercise is designed to update registries by eliminating duplicate names, deceased voters, and undocumented infiltrators while adding genuine new voters door to door.
